title: 58 啊是月光宝瓶菩萨来了2257 第二次推演结束12
slug: 苟在诸天从黑暗佛门开始
lines: 深秋的清晨，袅袅炊烟...
又是最初。
李玄闭上了眼，却不带半秒犹豫地消耗了剩下的那“1”点道点，进入了第三次推演，然后又毫不犹豫地把“25点技能点”加在了百年煞上。
瞬间...
技能点清空，百年煞一栏变成了“【百年煞（99100）】：32年妖力”。
呼~
长吐一口浊气。
不出所料，李玄心底的那些强烈思念、大彻大悟的感觉再度消失。
这次，他没再动，而是静静在被窝里，仰面看着窗户。
他挑开了窗。
窗外老树婆娑着树影。
闭目。
复盘。
第一个念头：渡厄想要控人，果然需要对方吞下丹药，否则上一次推演他回归之后，渡厄完全可以定住他，可并没有。
当他骑着金翅鸟横跨菩提城，停在寒衣巷；当渡厄带着玄然等人包围过来时，他们只敢远远看着，面显敬畏，却不敢上前。
再结合第一次推演那滚烫的池水，烧焦的证道院，还有金鱼妖魔...
结论已出。
他的面板随之一跳，探索度从“50”变成了“55”。
【世界探索度（55100）:八枚丹药果然是用来控制人的手段，最终的目的就是炼制出妖魔，这是一种速成之法，和《宝瓶功》类似，都是为了造出能被控制的傀儡】
第二个念头：孟莹想要度化他，为什么不早早动手？
第一次推演，孟莹等了三年；第二次推演，孟莹等了五年；她在等什么？
猫戏老鼠么？
上修没这么无聊。
若无必要，她应该不会去这么做。
但必要性又在哪儿？
上一次推演，他才在林南县野熊寺见到了孟莹，可当他用最快的速度飞回了菩提城后，孟莹早就在等他了，这说明对方的速度在他之上，对方寻他不是寻了五年，而是...等了五年。
为什么要等五年，而不是三年？
第三个念头：孟莹为什么要扮演一个深爱他的妻子的角色？
第一次推演孟莹用各种方式出现在他面前...
先是一封家书报平安，然后又是用《宝瓶功》和他产生交集，再然后...是秋收，再再然后是她被玄心当作威胁他的方式从而去烧香火，期间甚至无视了他的警告，无视了他“不要去烧香”的警告。
第二次...
content_en:
In the early morning of late autumn, the smoke from the kitchen...
It's the beginning again.
Li Xuan closed his eyes, but without half a second of hesitation, he consumed the remaining "1" Tao point, entered the third deduction, and then added "25 skill points" to the Hundred Years Sha without hesitation.
moment...
The skill points are cleared, and the column of Hundred Years Evil becomes "[Century Year Evil (99100)]: 32 years of demon power".
————
Phew~
Take a long breath.
As expected, the strong longing and enlightenment feeling in Li Xuan's heart disappeared again.
This time, he didn't move anymore, but quietly sat in bed, looking up at the window.
He opened the window.
The old trees outside the window cast their shadows.
Close your eyes.
Review.
The first thought: If Du E wants to control someone, he really needs the other person to swallow the pill. Otherwise, after the last deduction of his return, Du E could completely immobilize him, but he didn't.
When he rode the golden-winged bird across Bodhi City and stopped at Hanyi Alley; when Du E, Xuan Ran and others surrounded him, they only dared to watch from a distance, showing awe on their faces, but did not dare to step forward.
Combined with the scalding pool water, the burnt Zhengdao Temple, and the goldfish demon in the first deduction...
The conclusion has been drawn.
His panel jumped, and his exploration level changed from "50" to "55".
[World Exploration Degree (55100): The eight pills are indeed a means to control people. The ultimate goal is to refine demons. This is a quick method, similar to "Aquarius Skill", in order to create puppets that can be controlled]
Second thought: Meng Ying wanted to convert him, why didn’t she do it earlier?
For the first deduction, Meng Ying waited for three years; for the second deduction, Meng Ying waited for five years; what was she waiting for?
Cat playing with mouse?
Higher education is not so boring.
She probably wouldn't do it if it wasn't necessary.
But where is the necessity?
In the last deduction, he only met Meng Ying at the Wild Bear Temple in Linnan County, but when he flew back to Bodhi City at the fastest speed, Meng Ying had been waiting for him. This meant that the other party was faster than him. The other party had not been looking for him for five years, but... waited for five years.
Why wait five years instead of three?
The third thought: Why does Meng Ying play the role of a wife who loves him deeply?
For the first time, Meng Ying appeared in front of him in various ways...
First, there was a letter from home reporting that she was safe, then she interacted with him using "Aquarius Kung Fu", and then... the autumn harvest, and then she was used by Xuan Xin as a way to threaten him and burned incense. During this period, she even ignored his warning and ignored his warning "Don't burn incense".
The second time...
